notes.title: The first Disaster Drive playtest is nearly complete
notes.notes:
Hello playtesters!

The first ever [b]Disaster Drive[/b] playtest on Steam will come to an end this evening [b](5/9/21)[/b] at [b]9pm PST[/b]. Thank you to everyone who gave the first build of my upcoming arcade racing game a go! I'm actively working on the next playable version, which is set in a volcanic, mountainous landscape with longer and twistier roads for better drifting action!

As I continue to dial in the game's art style, I'll be occasionally sharing concept art. Here's one now:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40427150/5497f32cc02df43ff7eeec31c2ccc3dcd7bcde2b.jpg[/img]


To get notified about future [b]Disaster Drive[/b] playtests, visit [url=https://disaster-drive.com]disaster-drive.com[/url].
